import z3

# Create z3 solver
solver = z3.Solver()

# Variables: x[i] is the subset for integer (i+1), where i in 0..23
x = [z3.Int(f'x_{i}') for i in range(24)]

# Each x[i] in {0, 1, 2}
for i in range(24):
    solver.add(x[i] >= 0)
    solver.add(x[i] <= 2)

# Sum constraints for each subset
for j in range(3):
    subset_sum = z3.Sum([z3.If(x[i] == j, i+1, 0) for i in range(24)])
    solver.add(subset_sum == 100)

print("Solving...")
start = time.time()
result = solver.check()
end = time.time()
print(f"Result: {result} (took {end-start:.2f}s)")

if result == z3.sat:
    model = solver.model()
    solution = [model.evaluate(x[i]).as_long() for i in range(24)]
    print("Solution:", solution)
    
    # Verify
    for j in range(3):
        s = sum(i+1 for i in range(24) if solution[i] == j)
        print(f"Subset {j}: sum = {s}")
else:
    print("UNSAT")
